scripts._comment:supabase: node --env-file-if-exists feeds api/.env to the CLI for the env() substitutions in supabase/config.toml — the CLI has no --env-file flag and only reads a .env in its own cwd. Not shell sourcing: api/.env has an unquoted multi-word PEM. See AGENTS.md > supabase/.
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts._comment:e2e: Playwright lives here, not in web/, so the Cloudflare Workers build never installs or typechecks test tooling. The specs still sit next to the app they drive (web/tests/e2e); only the dependency and the runner are hoisted.
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:api && npm run test:e2e:web
